text: Bulk RNA-seq of entorhinal cortex showed higher expression of 9 V-ATPase subunit genes (the proton pump that acidifies endosomes and lysosomes) in aged APOE3/4 mice than in APOE3/3 mice (reported: log2 fold change 0.11-0.17).
description: Human APOE targeted-replacement mice (Sullivan et al.), male, 14-15 months; APOE3/4 (n=19) vs APOE3/3 (n=10); bulk RNA-seq (Illumina HiSeq, DESeq2, BH-FDR <0.05) of dissected entorhinal cortex tissue. Caveat: mouse, aged, bulk tissue (not human astrocytes), heterozygous E3/4; transcript level only, no pH measured; authors suggest upregulation may be compensatory.

provenance.excerpt: As highlighted in Figure 2, an important contributor to the difference in the vesicle function group was an increase in the expression of 9 Vacuolar H+-ATPases (V-ATPases) in the EC of APOE3/4 mice (Figure 3A).

meccogFinding.summary: (APOE3/3 -> APOE3/4) -> (higher V-ATPase subunit mRNA in entorhinal cortex) -> [inferred capacity for endosomal acidification; pH not measured]

perturbed.variable: APOE3/4 vs APOE3/3 genotype (human APOE targeted replacement)

measured.variable: mRNA expression of 9 V-type H+-ATPase subunits (Atp6v0b, Atp6v0d1, Atp6v0e2, Atp6v1b2, Atp6v1c1, Atp6v1d, Atp6v1e1, Atp6v1g1, Atp6v1g2) by RNA-seq
